description_en: Cancels the mute-all restriction in a room
description_zh: 调用CancelBanAllComment接口，取消房间内全员禁言的限制
kebab_example: aliyun imp cancel-ban-all-comment --app-id 7m000q --room-id AE350000T95F --user-id as0000hs --region cn-hangzhou
name: CancelBanAllComment

parameters.help_en: The ID of the application. This ID is generated when you create the application in the console. The value contains lowercase letters and digits and is 6 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用户的应用ID，在控制台创建应用时生成。包含小写字母、数字，长度为6个字符
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the room, which is returned when you call CreateRoom
parameters.help_zh: 房间的唯一标识，在调用CreateRoom时返回
parameters.name: room_id

parameters.help_en: The user ID of the operator, which indicates who performed the cancel mute-all operation
parameters.help_zh: 操作人的用户ID，用于表示谁执行了取消全员禁言操作
parameters.name: user_id
